chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, regarding the saying:
of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah?”
He عليه السلام said: “It means one who takes his opinion as his religion without an Imam from the Imams of guidance.”

key_terms.أَئِمَّةِ الْهُدَى: the Imams of guidance who lead people upon truth
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: a divinely authoritative guide to be followed in religion
key_terms.دِينَهُ: his religion, meaning the basis upon which he practices faith
key_terms.رَأْيَهُ: his own opinion or personal judgment
key_terms.هَوَاهُ: his personal desire or whim that he follows instead of guidance

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by the one who follows his desires without guidance from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the verse as referring to a person who bases religion on personal opinion rather than divine guidance. In the narration, true guidance in religion is tied to following an Imam from the Imams of guidance, not the inclinations of the self.
